metadata.model2026: Illustrative calibration to GPT-5.5 aggregate GDPval 84.9% (Apr 2026); not measured per-occupation
metadata.scoreMethod: Logistic uplift from original best-of-seven per-occupation 2025 scores; small capped relative task-success adjustment from Anthropic Feb 2026 matched O*NET tasks; calibrated to 84.9% mean across 44 occupations. This is NOT a head-to-head GPT-5.5 result.
metadata.taskMapping: May 2026 Anthropic Economic Index -> exact O*NET 30.1 Task ID -> O*NET SOC -> original GDPval 2018 SOC. Broad SOC expands to exact detailed descendants only. Shared tasks split across matches. February task success joined by normalized exact task text and treated as illustrative evidence only.
limitations: GDPval 2025 and Anthropic 2026 are different benchmarks and different models.
A task appearing in Claude usage is not proof the task is automated or has expert-quality results.
February Claude success is model-classified, not GDPval expert-graded.
May OEWS 2025 is newest annual wage vintage available by Oct 2026; no May OEWS 2026 estimates yet.
2026 colour is a scenario, not an occupational measurement or prediction of job losses.
Wage bill uses nationwide occupation employment and annual mean wage, not each sector's payroll.
